description: Översiktsplan - Vindkraftsplan is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Simrishamns kommun. The wind power plan is a thematic addition to the Master plan. The wind power plan forms a planning basis for the establishment of wind turbines in the municipality. The municipal council adopted the wind power plan on 19 December 2011. Coverage: Simrishamns kommun. The portal shows the English title as "Master Plan - Wind Power Plan" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Simrishamns kommun. Its keywords include Vindkraftsplanen, Antagen, Boundaries, Plangränser, Wind power plan, Förnybar energi. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WFS, WMS, PDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
